adds.title: ILGA-Europe Rainbow rankings - 2016, 2019, 2024
adds.summary: In 2026 Russia, including Mari El, scored 2% at the bottom of Europe with explicit bans/legal limitations making legal gender recognition practically impossible without self-determination or fully depathologised trans healthcare, and without full SOGIESC anti-discrimination coverage or hate-crime/hate-speech protection based on gender identity.
